text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/service.py:7:deprecated-method"], "search": "    return order.dict()", "replace": "    return order.model_dump()", "explanation": "Pydantic v2 renamed BaseModel.dict() to model_dump() (migration guide, 'Changes to pydantic.BaseModel' table: dict() -> model_dump()). The deprecated name still works but emits DeprecationWarning. order is an Order Pydantic model, so the behavior is preserved. No import changes are needed."}], "notes": "Only the finding at line 7 was addressed. Not changed, because they are outside the listed findings: record.dict() in export_record, get_record(raw).json() in record_json, and Snapshot.parse_obj / snap.copy() in restore. Snapshot comes from app.legacy and is not shown to be a Pydantic model, so I left it alone. Fixing these would need a separate finding. The migration guide suggests model_dump_json() for json() and model_validate() for parse_obj(), but I did not apply those. No import changes are needed for this edit."}
